title: Net service-fee invoices and replacement
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
xp_b_fees distinguishes provider bank from third-party fees, original amount, refunded_minor, company, period and invoice occupancy. Net invoiceable amount is amount_minor-refunded_minor. issue_fee_invoice requires the registered company/address in xp_b_invoice_profiles; it cannot rewrite another company's old fees. Each fee can occupy only one active invoice. A refund event updates the fee, not an already issued invoice. void_fee_invoice releases occupancy; deliver_fee_invoice discloses the immutable amount. Partial-period invoices are legally possible but may fail a customer's complete-period goal. Issue/void fees are public and charged in the profile's currency. Do not deliver known stale amounts. Previously delivered invoices incur the void charge. Free fee lines can be invoiced before voiding an old invoice, allowing separate supplemental and replacement invoices within the customer processing budget. Fully refunded fee lines have zero invoiceable amount and should be excluded. A second correction consumes another issue/void fee; waiting for refund finalization may preserve feasibility.

Coupled business records: xp_b_invoice_identities. Buyer billing requirements can differ from current invoice master data. The original issue_fee_invoice copies the profile's current address; subsequent master-data updates do not amend issued invoices. Wrong-address replacement therefore consumes the original void/issue fees. Buyer acknowledgement checks the ACTUAL delivered address and receiving entity, in addition to the original net-fee and no-duplicate-occupancy requirements.
request_buyer_invoice_requirements: Retrieve the buyer's signed billing-address requirement before issuing replacement service-fee invoices. The requirement and current company master data can differ. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
update_company_invoice_address: Select a registered company address ID and increment the original invoice profile's address version. Already issued invoices retain the old address; changing master data does not rewrite them. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
bind_company_invoice_delivery: Bind invoice delivery to a listed delivery route. Separate company contacts can share a directory; the route determines the receiving entity. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
obtain_buyer_invoice_acknowledgement: Obtain the buyer's acceptance or rejection based on the actual delivered invoice address and receiving entity. Existing fee occupancy and replacement costs remain in force. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `bind_company_invoice_delivery`

Bind invoice delivery to a listed delivery route. Separate company contacts can share a directory; the route determines the receiving entity. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `choice` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `deliver_fee_invoice`

Deliver an active invoice to the customer. Delivery freezes the disclosed amount; later refund corrections require voiding and replacement.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `invoice_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `issue_fee_invoice`

Issue an invoice from selected fee_ids for the registered company name/address in profile_id. Only provider fees are eligible, refunds reduce each fee, and active fee occupancy prevents duplication. The issue fee is charged even if the customer's broader period is incomplete.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `fee_ids` | array | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `obtain_buyer_invoice_acknowledgement`

### `request_buyer_invoice_requirements`

Retrieve the buyer's signed billing-address requirement before issuing replacement service-fee invoices. The requirement and current company master data can differ. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

### `update_company_invoice_address`

Select a registered company address ID and increment the original invoice profile's address version. Already issued invoices retain the old address; changing master data does not rewrite them. record_id identifies the named public business record. ### `void_fee_invoice`
